title: 1 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 20
description: Ten questions on 1 Kings 20: Ben Hadad's siege of Samaria, Israel's two victories over Syria, and the prophet's verdict when Ahab let Ben Hadad go.

questions.text: How many kings were with Ben Hadad when he besieged Samaria?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 20:1 says Ben Hadad gathered all his army, and there were thirty-two kings with him.

answers.text: Twelve
Seventeen
Thirty-two
Forty-one

questions.text: What did the elders and the people tell Ahab about Ben Hadad's second demand?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 20:8 says all the elders and all the people told him, "Don't listen, and don't consent."

answers.text: "Don't listen, and don't consent."
"Give him all he asks for."
"Flee to Judah at once."
"Ask Elijah what to do."

questions.text: What did Ahab tell Ben Hadad about putting on armor?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 20:11 Ahab answers, "Don't let him who puts on his armor brag like he who takes it off."

answers.text: He should put it on before the sun rises
He should take it off and make peace
He would never need to wear it again
He should not brag like one who takes it off

questions.text: By whom did Yahweh say he would deliver the great multitude into Ahab's hand?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 20:14 the prophet says, "By the young men of the princes of the provinces."

answers.text: The elders of the land of Israel
The young men of the princes of the provinces
The prophets of Yahweh
Jehoshaphat's army from Judah

questions.text: What was Ben Hadad doing when the young men went out at noon?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 20:16 says Ben Hadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the thirty-two kings who helped him.

answers.text: Praying to the gods of Syria
Sleeping in an inner room
Building ramps against the wall
Getting drunk in the pavilions

questions.text: Why did the Syrians say Israel had been stronger than they were?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 20:23 the servants say, "Their god is a god of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we."

answers.text: Israel had more horses and chariots
Their king had better counselors
Their god is a god of the hills
The Syrians had been drunk

questions.text: What were the children of Israel like when they encamped before the Syrians?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 20:27 says the children of Israel encamped before them like two little flocks of young goats, but the Syrians filled the country.

answers.text: A great swarm of locusts
Two little flocks of young goats
Lions in the forest
The sand on the seashore

questions.text: What did Ben Hadad's servants put on when they went to the king of Israel?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 20:32 says they put sackcloth on their bodies and ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel.

answers.text: Sackcloth on their bodies and ropes on their heads
Royal robes on their bodies and crowns of gold
Armor and helmets of bronze
Ashes on their heads and torn clothes

questions.text: What happened to the man who refused to strike the prophet?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 20:36 says that as soon as he had departed, a lion found him and killed him.

answers.text: He became a leper that day
He was struck blind
He was taken captive by Syria
A lion found him and killed him

questions.text: Why did the prophet say Ahab's life would take the place of the other man's life?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 20:42 the prophet says it is because Ahab let go out of his hand the man whom Yahweh had devoted to destruction.

answers.text: He had worshiped Baal in Samaria
He let go the man Yahweh had devoted to destruction
He had not gone out to the battle
He had killed the prophets of Yahweh
